quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings release, operating segment data (in thousands): Aerospace & Defense net sales $416,540 (Q3 2025 $344,482) with segment operating income $77,041 ($56,010); Commercial net sales $787,882 ($408,920) with segment operating income $166,279 ($60,031); total segment operating income $243,320 ($116,041). First three quarters of 2026 end-market mix: Aerospace and Defense 37%, Automotive 8%, Data Center and Networking 39%, Medical, Industrial, and Instrumentation 16% (45%, 11%, 30%, 14% a year earlier). Capital expenditures, net were $79,921 in Q3 2026 ($99,233 in Q3 2025) and $237,138 in the first three quarters. Balance sheet at September 28, 2026: cash and cash equivalents $876,347, contract assets $793,552, inventories $325,432, property, plant and equipment, net $1,286,879 (December 29, 2025: $501,234, $468,006, $250,057, $1,010,710). Footnote: prior-year end-market revenue was recast for the merged Data Center Computing and Networking end markets, and segment data for the realignment of the RF and Specialty Components segment within A&D in the quarter ended March 30, 2026.

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings release, acquisition status (operating facts only): on October 9, 2026 TTM entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Merlin Circuit Technology Ltd. and Merlin Flex Ltd., 'two small printed circuit board fabrication factories in the United Kingdom', subject to regulatory approvals and expected to close during the fourth quarter of 2026; the planned acquisition of ILFA GmbH, a German printed circuit manufacturer, is expected to close during the fourth quarter of 2026. Both, and the planned Ophir Optics acquisition, are excluded from current guidance; the completed Swiss Technology Group and Epiq Solutions acquisitions are included in it.
